title: Legal Forwarding Agreements Intake Matrix — Placement Stages, Debt Types and Open-Matter Limits
content:
Each forwarding programme of the Legal Forwarding Agreements accepts accounts only from listed placement stages and of listed debt types, and holds no more than a set number of open forwarded matters under one agreement. The matrices below give those three programme terms for every programme. "Yes" means the stage or debt type is on the programme's list; "No" means it is not.

## Matrix A — placement stages whose accounts may be forwarded

| Placement stage | Attorney Demand Program | Small Claims Suit Program | Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program | Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program | Judgment Enforcement Program | Full-Service Litigation Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Early-Out Placement | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Primary Placement | Yes | No | No | No | No | No |
| Secondary Placement | Yes | No | No | No | No | No |
| Tertiary Placement | Yes | No | No | No | No | No |
| Warehouse Placement | Yes | No | No | No | No | No |
| Legal Review Placement | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

The Attorney Demand Program lists Primary, Secondary, Tertiary, Warehouse and Legal Review Placement. Every other programme lists Legal Review Placement alone. No programme lists Early-Out Placement.

## Matrix B — debt types the programme accepts

| Debt type | Attorney Demand Program | Small Claims Suit Program | Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program | Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program | Judgment Enforcement Program | Full-Service Litigation Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medical | Yes | No | No | No | No | No |
| Bank card | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Utility | Yes | Yes | No | No | Yes | No |
| Telecom | Yes | Yes | No | No | Yes | No |
| Auto deficiency | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Private student loan | Yes | No | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |
| Retail installment | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

Read by programme:

- Attorney Demand Program — medical, bank card, utility, telecom, auto deficiency, private student loan, retail installment.
- Small Claims Suit Program — bank card, utility, telecom, auto deficiency, retail installment.
- Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program — bank card, auto deficiency, private student loan, retail installment.
- Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program — bank card, auto deficiency, retail installment.
- Judgment Enforcement Program — bank card, utility, telecom, auto deficiency, private student loan, retail installment.
- Full-Service Litigation Program — bank card, auto deficiency, private student loan, retail installment.

Medical debt is on the Attorney Demand Program's list only.

## Matrix C — largest number of open forwarded matters under one agreement

| Programme | Open-matter limit per agreement |
|---|---|
| Attorney Demand Program | 25 |
| Small Claims Suit Program | 100 |
| Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program | 500 |
| Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program | 250 |
| Judgment Enforcement Program | 500 |
| Full-Service Litigation Program | 2000 |

## Sample readings (hypothetical accounts)

- A hypothetical utility account at Legal Review Placement appears on both lists of the Small Claims Suit Program and the Judgment Enforcement Program, and on neither the debt-type list of the Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program nor that of the Full-Service Litigation Program.
- A hypothetical bank card account at Tertiary Placement is on the stage list of the Attorney Demand Program only.
- A hypothetical medical account at Legal Review Placement is on both lists of the Attorney Demand Program only.
